reason: User requests one strategy suited to three daily auction order windows; tighten execution assumptions before deployment.
calendar: Remove stock dates without actual SET100 index bars; missing stock sessions remain missing, not manufactured.
selection: Reference is comparison only. A candidate must have higher full and 2024-onward CAGR than the same-exclusion basket in every scenario, and full/recent max drawdown no worse than -25% in every scenario. Among passers choose highest minimum full-period CAGR, then smallest worst drawdown. If none pass, nominate the least-bad candidate by the same score for paper-only investigation and explicitly fail the research gate. No expansion of the grid after results.
execution: Prior-close quantities, cash funded before auction, sale proceeds available only at a later window, 35% funding envelope, per-window capacity limited to 1% of preceding daily turnover. Daily open and close are proxies; afternoon auction and real auction liquidity are unavailable. Fractional adjusted units remain a limitation.
live_readiness: Historical performance cannot pass live readiness alone. Verified point-in-time membership, complete auction data and corporate actions, broker sandbox, lot/fee metadata, user capital/risk limits, and fresh forward paper operation remain necessary.
